_comment: Add a _ before an option name to comment it out and it wont be added to the apworld
Using 'goal' as the name of an option let you override some of the generated goal parameters
goal.description: How to End your Randomized playthrough.

filler_traps._comment: Using values here let you set a 'recommended' filler_trap percentage or even a default percentage

description: This is a Toggle
A simple boolean, aka True or False set the initial value with "default"
Indicate whether you are starting with a brand new save file or starting with an existing file.

With this enabled, logic is restricted to what you can actually access within a new save file, while disabling this opens up logic as though you were playing an existing save with everything available.
This option enables specific level unlock mode. Recommended with an existing save file.
With this enabled, it adds items that unlock each individual level, for example: 'Level Unlock! ALAP 1'
With this disabled, you will receive the fans instead, with all of their associated levels available when you receive them.
Turns on and off cousinsanity, where rolling as each cousin individually counts as a check.
Turns on and off presentsanity, where rolling with each present individually counts as a check
Enables the longest checks in the game. These would be the last two cousins of both ALAP 4 and ALAP 5, due to those levels being exceedingly long and the one cousin limit for new cousins.
If playing in an existing save, it is recommended to have these checks enabled.
Enables the most difficult checks in the game. These are all super clears, including Cowbear, Fast Friends, Cleaning, Fast Underwater, and 1000 Cranes
Enables trap items into the manual. These can be anything from being unable to dash or roll blind.
This is a Choice
Let the user pick from a list of values
allow_custom_value let a player define their own text value
Currently the only use for Choice in Manual outside of hooks is the goal
This is a Range
Allow the player to specify a value between 'start' and 'end'
if you include a "values" you can define the label for certain values
Currently the only use for Range in Manual outside of hooks is 'filler_trap'
